_notes: plan: 'balíček' everywhere (the established term in cs common/student/marketing); 'tarif' and 'plán podpory' in student:v29.services.legacyContract, mobile:v29.plan.upgradePending, mobile:v3.home.noCounselor unified to it.
matches: kept 'shody' (used across cs common/marketing/success as 'Silná shoda', 'Moje shody'); mobile:signup.quickGo aligned to it. It is a calque; changing it would need a cross-product decision.

standard admission letter: 'standardní dopis o přijetí' per brief (student:v22.home.appTeam.letter, mobile:v3.visa.beforeBody, new keys). Note: cs common.json/marketing.json/student.json elsewhere use 'standardní potvrzení o přijetí' - owner to pick one and align those files.
visa document preparation: 'příprava dokumentů k vízu' (was 'Příprava žádosti o vízum' / 'Příprava na vízum'); says what we do, never implies a visa is issued.
managed application: 'Přihlášky vedené týmem' in all three allowance/feature keys (was three different renderings).

settlement support: 'Pomoc po příjezdu' (+ 'a se zabydlením' where English says settling-in); personal statement/study plan: 'motivační dopis' / 'studijní plán' (not 'plán studia'); editing = 'úpravy', review = 'kontrola', official verification = 'ověření'.

Hangyul team vs counselor: four mobile strings said 'poradce' where English says 'the Hangyul team'; changed to 'tým Hangyul'. 'tým Hangyul' / 'tým Hangyul Univ' follow the English per key; a few existing harmless mismatches left alone.

vykání: new strings are written gender-neutral (no past participle); two existing 'Jste přijati' lines rephrased as 'Univerzita vás přijala'. Existing plural-participle strings ('kde jste skončili', 'Dokončili jste') left as-is - common Czech UI convention, change only if the owner wants strict singular with (a).
plurals: added the Czech _few (2-4) form to every plural group and made _one/_other agree with the noun; _many (fractions) not added because every count is an integer.

document titles with {{label}} (mobile:v4.home.item.*.title): rendered as 'dokument {{label}}' apposition so the inserted label stays in nominative; essay titles take the label directly (motivační dopis / studijní plán are inanimate masculine, accusative = nominative).

certified translation = 'úředně ověřený překlad'; consular legalization = 'konzulární superlegalizace'; apostille = 'apostila'; mock interview kept as existing 'zkušební pohovor' (success.json uses 'cvičný pohovor' - owner may unify).
mobile:app.* product names kept in English as official names.
